question: 固定价格、扩散与交易拥挤排序在实际月度换仓和成本后是否保留配置价值？
scope: R01 SW2014/SW2021 L2/L3 separately; all feature-ready industries common to F, FD and FC; no optimize or universe cherry-pick
rebalance: completed month-end signals, next benchmark trading session close entry, next origin's next-session close exit; equal target weights; drift old weights until rebalance
universe: common feature-ready set before viewing future returns; min20 industries; selected missing future path invalidates that interval, no replacement or zero return. Report all invalid intervals. Whole-strategy compounded metric withheld if any interval invalid; valid interval averages descriptive only.
classification_boundary: exclude scheduled intervals whose exit after 2021-11-30 for SW2014, or before 2022-01-01 for SW2021; no bridge or splicing
cost: 0/20/50 bps times sum(abs(target weights - drifted old weights)); first entry turnover=1, final liquidation=1; no holding overlap reductions beyond own industry positions; fees deducted from wealth, research convention
benchmark: same-entry/exits CSI_ALL and common-industry equal weight; synthetic stock baskets, not published sector indices or investable portfolio
risk: gross and net CAGR/drawdown if all intervals valid; daily beta vs CSI_ALL, annualized volatility; maximum industry weight, actual weight turnover; stock overlap/liquidity/tradability gaps separately unresolved
inference: descriptive attribution only, no new statistical acceptance after inspecting R01. Positive after-cost performance alone does not establish prediction, mechanism or investability.
stop: do not tune top fraction, weights, dates or costs based on results
